notes: `מַלְאֲכֵי הָאֱלֹהִים` is read with fronting: the article on the anarthrously rendered rectum takes the phrase's one *the* (rule 29).
`עַד־לְאֵין` divides as rule 30 directs — *till* to `עַד`, the copula to `לְ`, and *there ... no* to the existential, headed on *no* (rule 50).
The periphrastic `יִּהְיוּ` carries the person and number and takes only the subject pronoun; each participle keeps its own lexical verb (rules 2, 17).
